content.comment_body: Hello, I'm developing a program to automatically switch off a self-holding relay after a fixed time, but I can't find timer functions such as TON or other timing options in the [product_name] software. Is there an alternative way to implement a timer and stop the relay automatically? Thank you for your support.

Hello [user_name], English is preferred in this forum, so please post in English. To answer your question, you're posting in the [product_name] software section. It's not clear if you are referring to [product_name] hardware, but this platform does include a TON timer. You can locate it in the 'Special Function --> Timer' menu, listed as 'ON-Delay.'

analysis.insight_summary: A user is having trouble finding discrete timer functions like ON-Delay (TON) within the [product_name] software while implementing a timed relay control. Another user clarifies these functions are available, suggesting potential usability challenges in finding features, particularly for newcomers or non-English speakers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect standard timing features such as TON and ON-Delay to be clearly accessible in the [company_name] programming environment to automate relay operations within their projects.
